purpose: Audit ISBN/publication/artifact metadata for revised PEP primary mathematics volumes. Metadata is accepted only when the artifact is edition-identified and consistent with the authoritative revised-series unit sequence.
acceptance_rule: An ISBN or publication record is attached to the revised series only when the edition/date and/or visible contents distinguish it from the 2022 illustrated legacy edition. Title alone is insufficient.
